newsitem.title: UK: European cotton trading patterns little changed.
newsitem.headline: European cotton trading patterns little changed.

text.p: The pattern of trading in raw cotton remained mostly unchanged on Friday, traders said.
West European spinners continued to enquire pricipally for supplies needed to cover their nearby shipment requirements, while some mill buyers are beginning to test prices further forward.
Central Asian and various African better grades have found buyers in Italy, and a fair level of underlying demand has been discernible on several other markets.
